definition: קַוְקָו (or קַוְקַו , קָוְקָו ) noun [masculine] might (?); — so read (according to most) for קַוקָֿו in phrase ׳ גּוֺי ק Isa 18:2 ; Isa 18:7 i.e. a mighty nation (compare Arabic strength ; see (on reduplication) Ges «GKC:123e»§ 123e ); > RV ' meting out ' conquered lands, literally 'of line, line' (11. קַו ).
